name: Mountaineer Kadrell
summary: Across from the Stoutlager Inn in Thelsamar, Mountaineer Kadrell keeps watch over Loch Modan.

sections.title: The Sentry of Thelsamar
sections.body: Mountaineer Kadrell watches over Thelsamar and directs Loch Modan’s dwarven defenses. Troggs, gnolls, and native beasts press against outposts along the valley’s edges. From the town’s center, Kadrell sends reinforcements, relays orders, and considers reports from scouts in the field.

sections.title: Keeping the Lines Open
sections.body: Mountaineer Kadrell stays in touch with Thelsamar’s distant forward posts. He coordinates with Mountaineer Stormpike and sends adventurers to report to sentries such as Mountaineer Rockgar. The outposts guard the mountain passes, so Kadrell helps supply them, reinforce their ranks, and carry word of threats.

faq.q: Where can Mountaineer Kadrell be found?
faq.answer: Mountaineer Kadrell can be found across the road from the Stoutlager Inn in Thelsamar, among Loch Modan’s rolling hills.

faq.q: What is Kadrell's role in Loch Modan?
faq.answer: Mountaineer Kadrell serves with the dwarven Mountaineers, carrying messages between Thelsamar’s local leaders and distant guard posts. He coordinates patrols, supplies, and reports from the border.

faq.q: Why do other mountaineers send runners to Kadrell?
faq.answer: Mountaineer Kadrell is stationed by Thelsamar’s inn and main thoroughfare, where field dispatches can reach him. Urgent reports from distant scouts pass through him to the settlement’s defenses.
Mountaineer Kadrell works with other mountaineers in the field, including Mountaineer Stormpike and Mountaineer Rockgar. They share scouting reports and arrange defenses against local threats.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler passing through Thelsamar, you can carry messages and aid distant mountaineer outposts facing regional threats.
As a dwarf, you know Kadrell belongs to the Mountaineer corps. Their watch protects Ironforge’s eastern territories from dangers in the wilderness.
